nodes.name: Webhook: Receive WA Message
nodes.notes: Entry point from Evolution API webhook. Accepts incoming WhatsApp events.

nodes.name: HTTP: Read Bot Settings (DB)
nodes.notes: حدود الإرسال من تبويب الإعدادات في اللوحة.

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { const d = ($json.body?.data ?? $json.body?.body?.data ?? $json.data); const m = d?.message || {}; return m.conversation ?? m.extendedTextMessage?.text ?? m.imageMessage?.caption ?? m.videoMessage?.caption ?? m.documentMessage?.caption ?? m.listResponseMessage?.title ?? m.buttonsResponseMessage?.selectedDisplayText ?? ''; })() }}

={{ (() => { const d = ($json.body?.data ?? $json.body?.body?.data ?? $json.data) || {}; const t = Number(d.messageTimestamp); const sec = Number.isFinite(t) && t > 1e12 ? Math.floor(t / 1000) : t; if (!Number.isFinite(sec) || sec <= 0) return 9999; return (Date.now() / 1000) - sec; })() }}
conditions.rightValue: ={{ (() => { try { const n = Number($('HTTP: Read Bot Settings (DB)').first().json.settings?.message_max_age_seconds); return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n : 300; } catch { return 300; } })() }}

nodes.name: IF: Valid Message?
nodes.notes: Guards: ignore own messages, empty text, old events, and group chats.

nodes.name: Code: Log Invalid Reason
nodes.notes: سبب رفض الرسالة — للتشخيص في تنفيذ n8n فقط (لا يُكتب في message_log / الداشبورد).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ phone: $json.normalized_phone, message: $json.inbound_text || '', keyword_matched: '[filter] ' + $json.invalid_reason, reply_sent: null, status: 'inbound_filtered', message_id: $json.message_id || null, timestamp: $json.received_at }) }}

nodes.name: HTTP: DB Ingest Message (Filtered)
nodes.notes: معطّل — لا يُستدعى من سير العمل. أحداث الفلتر تُسجَّل في تنفيذ n8n فقط (لا message_log).

assignments.name: phone
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const d = ($json.body?.data ?? $json.body?.body?.data ?? $json.data) || {}; const src = [d.sender, d.remoteJidAlt, d.key?.remoteJidAlt, d.key?.remoteJid].find(v => typeof v === 'string' && v.includes('@s.whatsapp.net')) || [d.sender, d.remoteJidAlt, d.key?.remoteJidAlt, d.key?.remoteJid].find(v => typeof v === 'string' && v.length) || ''; return src.replace('@s.whatsapp.net', '').replace(/\D/g, ''); })() }}

assignments.name: message_text
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const m = ($json.body?.data ?? $json.body?.body?.data ?? $json.data)?.message || {}; return (m.conversation ?? m.extendedTextMessage?.text ?? m.imageMessage?.caption ?? m.videoMessage?.caption ?? m.documentMessage?.caption ?? m.listResponseMessage?.title ?? m.buttonsResponseMessage?.selectedDisplayText ?? '').trim(); })() }}

nodes.name: Set: Extract Fields
nodes.notes: Normalizes payload fields used by the workflow (phone, text, message_id, timestamp).

nodes.name: HTTP: Read Keywords (DB)
nodes.notes: يجلب الكلمات من Supabase (نفس مصدر لوحة التحكم) — لا تعتمد على شيت Google.

nodes.name: Code: Keywords DB to Rows
nodes.notes: يحوّل استجابة { keywords: [...] } إلى صفوف كما كان يخرجها Google Sheets.

nodes.name: Code: Dedup & Volume Check
nodes.notes: Anti-ban protection: dedup by message_id/text, per-user cooldown, global per-minute limit, and daily cap.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ phone: $json.phone, message: $json.message_text, keyword_matched: '[dedup] ' + ($json.block_reason || ''), reply_sent: null, status: 'dedup_blocked', message_id: $json.message_id, timestamp: $json.received_at }) }}

nodes.name: HTTP: DB Ingest Message (Dedup Blocked)
nodes.notes: تسجيل وارد صُممت إجابته لكن dedup منع الإرسال — يظهر سبب الحظر في keyword_matched.

parameters.url: ={{ 'https://evolution.growleadpro.com'.replace(/\/+$/, '') + '/message/sendText/' + (($('Webhook: Receive WA Message').first().json.body || {}).instance || ($('Webhook: Receive WA Message').first().json.body || {}).body?.instance || 'Yas') }}
parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ number: $json.phone, text: $json.reply, delay: 1500, linkPreview: false }) }}

nodes.name: HTTP: Send Reply
nodes.notes: Sends reply via Evolution. Env vars override embedded fallbacks: EVOLUTION_API_URL, EVOLUTION_INSTANCE, EVOLUTION_API_KEY.

nodes.name: Code: Email Extract & Classify
nodes.notes: Extracts email from message text via regex, normalizes to lowercase, and classifies intent_type using Butterfly Digital Marketing keyword guide (free_gifts / paid_products / planner_order / full_bundle / free_consultation / private_consultation / other).

nodes.name: IF: Has Email?
nodes.notes: TRUE → message contains email → look up / upsert in email_leads sheet. FALSE → no email found → skip lead processing.

nodes.name: No Op: No Email
nodes.notes: Message contained no email address — lead not created. Reply path already completed.

nodes.name: IF: No Email Has Phone?
nodes.notes: Without email, only create no_email lead when user sends a phone number in the same message.

nodes.name: IF: Outgoing Message?
nodes.notes: Human handoff: detects manual replies sent from WhatsApp (fromMe=true).

assignments.name: phone
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const d = ($json.body?.data ?? $json.body?.body?.data ?? $json.data) || {}; const src = [d.sender, d.remoteJidAlt, d.key?.remoteJidAlt, d.key?.remoteJid].find(v => typeof v === 'string' && v.includes('@s.whatsapp.net')) || [d.sender, d.remoteJidAlt, d.key?.remoteJidAlt, d.key?.remoteJid].find(v => typeof v === 'string' && v.length) || ''; return src.replace('@s.whatsapp.net', '').replace(/\D/g, ''); })() }}

nodes.name: IF: Chat Paused?
nodes.notes: Stops bot + leads when chat is in human handoff (24h from last manual reply).

nodes.name: HTTP: DB Ingest Message
nodes.notes: بعد إرسال الرد — يكتب في Supabase (متوازي مع الشيت).

nodes.name: HTTP: DB Ingest Message (No Reply)
nodes.notes: رسالة بدون رود تلقائي.

nodes.name: HTTP: DB Ingest Message (Paused)
nodes.notes: محادثة موقوفة — تسجيل واردة فقط.

nodes.name: HTTP: DB Ingest Paused Chat
nodes.notes: إيقاف الرد التلقائي 24 ساعة في Supabase.

nodes.notes: يقرأ paused_chats من Supabase.

nodes.name: HTTP: Read Paused Chats Handoff (DB)
nodes.notes: يقرأ paused_chats من Supabase.

nodes.notes: Dedup من yassmin.message_log — يتطلب N8N secret أو anon كما في ingest.

nodes.name: Code: Flatten Message Log
nodes.notes: يحوّل { rows } إلى عناصر متعددة كما كان يفعل شيت message_log.

nodes.name: HTTP: Read Bot Outbound (DB)
nodes.notes: للمقارنة مع message_id الصادر (بديل شيت bot_outbound).

nodes.notes: فرع الإيميل: لاحقًا POST إلى Edge أو جدول email_leads — لا Google Sheets.
